When you start Sabbaq, it uses the \"Accessibility\" permission to read the order screen shown in supported apps only. It reads the order texts and the details of the screen elements, such as their description, identifiers, type, the accept button\'s position and whether it can be tapped.

If the order matches your saved conditions for fare, distance, time and excluded words, Sabbaq can tap the accept button once. You set the conditions and decide when to turn the feature on or off. The feature makes no independent decisions and uses no artificial intelligence to choose.

The screen details are processed on your device, and the accessibility service does not send them over the internet. Account and subscription data are stored separately through the account service, as the privacy policy explains.
